notes.subject: ירנן/ירעע
notes.rationale: Kĩhibirania kĩarĩ kũhana ta-inĩ: kũina na kũigua ũgu — mĩario ĩĩrĩ ihananine gĩkonjo kĩa kwendwo nĩ andũ, gĩthingo gĩake gĩtihota kũhũthĩra Gĩkũyũ.

notes.subject: הידד
notes.rationale: Kiugo gĩkĩ kĩa kũigua ũgu wa andũ arĩa marĩ mahiga-inĩ — gĩcunjĩ kĩa Isaia 16:10 kĩrĩ na kĩũmbe kĩa kũigua ũgu; ta 'ũgu wa mbũgũ' kana 'ũgu-ũrĩa-ũgwatĩte' handũ ha 'kũigua ũgu wa mahiga'.

notes.subject: הידד
notes.rationale: Hebrew heidad is the vintage-shout itself, not just cheering; Gĩkũyũ 'ũgu-ũrĩa-ũgwatĩte' keeps the shout, loses the harvest link.

translation: Na gĩkeno na kũgĩakĩra nĩkĩnyitithanwo kuuma kĩanda gĩa mĩmera; na kĩanda-inĩ gĩa mĩmera ti kũinwo, ti kũigua ũgu ũrĩa ũgwatĩte; mũthiũrũri aragĩta mũgĩna ti mũgĩna handũ harĩa mahiga ma kũnyiitira mũgĩna marĩ; ũgu-ũrĩa-ũgwatĩte nĩnĩciarii kũikara.

tokens.gloss: handũ harĩa mahiga ma kũnyiitira mũgĩna marĩ
